auto.description: Run cleanup automatically after hydra start and hydra update

intervalHours.description: Minimum hours between automatic cleanup runs

lastRun.description: ISO timestamp of the last cleanup run; managed by Hydra, do not edit by hand

olderThanDays.description: Prune log files older than this many days

targets.description: What to clean: _diag log files, _work job workspaces, unused shared runner versions

directory.description: Directory where runners will be created

hosts.description: Hosts that must all resolve before the job starts

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for DNS before failing the job

workspaceCleanup.description: Job-completed hook that removes the job's workspace and _temp contents from the runner's _work directory

enabled.description: Install the cleanup hook; hydra init turns it on for new profiles

keepToolCache.description: Keep _work/_tool; set to false to empty the tool cache after every job as well

labels.description: Comma-separated list of labels for the runners

numberOfMachines.description: Number of runner machines to create

run.description: Whether to start runners immediately after creation

runnerGroup.description: Runner group to assign runners to (applies to organization runners)

url.description: GitHub repository URL (https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>) or organization URL (https://github.com/<org>)

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the runner was created

name.description: Runner name as registered with the provider

provider.description: Provider the runner is registered with

url.description: Repository or organization URL the runner is registered against
